title: standardized joints and replaceable repairs

specimens.name: Standardized welded T-joint
specimens.description: Two factory-cut steel plates at 90° with a neat consistent fillet weld bead and square preparation; controlled industrial weld only, no crude repair patch.

specimens.name: Stamped triangular gusset bracket
specimens.description: One pressed/folded steel gusset with identical punched mounting holes and clean repeatable edges; single standardized bracket only.

specimens.name: Bolted lap joint
specimens.description: Two overlapping steel plates joined by identical zinc-plated hex bolts, nuts and washers in perfectly even spacing; no mismatched fasteners.

specimens.name: Spot-welded sheet-metal seam
specimens.description: Two overlapping thin steel edges with a regular row of identical spot-weld marks; clean repeatable seam only.

specimens.name: Replaceable bolted reinforcement plate
specimens.description: One rectangular strengthening/splice plate fixed with an even standardized bolt pattern, designed to be removable rather than field-welded.

specimens.name: Folded L-bracket
specimens.description: One-piece stamped/folded steel angle bracket with a flanged edge and two identical punched mounting holes; no rough hand-cut plate.

specimens.name: Standardized channel splice
specimens.description: Two short channel ends joined locally by paired identical splice plates and uniform bolts; local splice only, not a full frame.

specimens.name: Modular box-section frame node
specimens.description: Short box-section fragments meeting at one local node with repeatable bolt-on gusset plates; local node only, not a complete frame.

global_forbidden: baked cast shadows or contact shadows
glow, bloom, rays or temporary FX

era_contract.character: serial industrial fabrication with repeatable hole patterns, interchangeable brackets and controlled welds
